integrity: All exact symbolic coefficient claims are verified in standalone checker.py, with independently constructed full 16x16 Liouvillian and direct concurrence cross-checks. Numerical samples do not replace analytic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Unconditional stationary concurrence for an XX dimer with a bit-flip channel on qubit one, phase-flip channel on qubit two, and complete Poisson resets to |00>; all rates positive. No proof for arbitrary channel mixtures, thermal effects, many bodies, finite-time dynamics or experimental performance. Independent priority evaluation remains open.
title: Universal single-onset entanglement under mixed-axis qubit noise and global resetting
